steps.text: A forest has many neighbours. Each animal finds food, water, and a safe place to sleep in a different part of the forest.
Where do most birds build their nests?
Right! Trees keep nests safe from many animals on the ground, and the branches hold them steady in the wind.
Think about the branches above you. Birds build nests in trees, where most animals below cannot reach them.
Rabbits dig burrows underground. Fish stay in the water. Bees build hives in hollow trunks. Every animal has its own place.
Nice work! You matched the birds to the trees, the rabbits to burrows, and the fish to water.
